description: Primal Attention: Self-Attention through Asymmetric Kernel SVD in Primal Representation.  Nyström-inspired low-rank landmark approximation of self-attention using segment pooling landmarks and iterative Schulz pseudoinverse refinement.  Supports: - Multi-architecture copy_weights (GPT-2, RoBERTa/BERT nested, Qwen/LLaMA, DistilBERT) - Trainable LoRA adapters with frozen base weights - GQA with repe

components.math_latex: \Delta y_t = x_t (B A)^\top \cdot \frac{\alpha}{r}, \quad A \in \mathbb{R}^{r \times d_{in}}, \; B \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{out} \times r}
